data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Western Front Bases Shift as Fighting Intensifies
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the western arc has further quickened. Weathered Expanse added two fresh ownership changes in the past two hours and five in the last six, keeping its daily total at forty‑one flips, while Stlican Shelf recorded eight new turns in six hours for a running tally of thirty. Godcrofts heated again with three flips in the last two hours and eight in six, pushing its daily count to twenty. Farranac Coast logged four recent changes, bringing its day‑total to nine, and Stonecradle added three more flips in six hours for ten overall. Deadlands saw three new events in the last six hours, raising its daily figure to sixteen, whereas Fishermans Row and Callahans Passage have gone quiet in the past two hours. Casualty streams show accelerating losses on both sides in Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Deadlands and Callahans Passage, while Farranac Coast, Fishermans Row, Kings Cage and Stonecradle are cooling. Enlistment rates are rising sharply in Callahans Passage and Kings Cage, modestly accelerating in Marban Hollow, but falling in Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Godcrofts, Deadlands, Farranac Coast and Linn Mercy. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held south remain static with no base turnovers.
